children: Srinivas Rao Ravuri, CIO of Bajaj Life Insurance, sees AI creating opportunities for Indian IT rather than disrupting it. He prefers mid-cap IT and remains bullish on autos and consumer discretionary, backed by strong demand and the potential Pay Commission boost. Could these sectors drive the next market winners?
